LOSSY AND ASYMMETRIC. "Injured, severity unknown" -- 1,320 persons. Maps to 0 (unknown), NOT to 2. The person is known to be injured but the degree is not recorded, and no other source has a code for that; collapsing it into "possible injury" would invent a severity the record does not assert. severity_note=INJURED_UNKNOWN preserves the fact that injury occurred.

"Died prior to crash" -- 17 persons. Maps to 0, NOT to 5. These deaths are not crash outcomes (medical event at the wheel); scoring them as fatal injuries would attribute a death to a crash that did not cause it.
Unknown. 8,580 persons. Distinct from 5: here it is not known whether the person was injured at all.
